contexts.text: So long as they are in falsity they cannot be intromitted into heavenly Societies...
At last... they are intromitted into good Societies, and are instructed.
Then first can they be intromitted into the light of heavenly things...
The entrance of the people into... Canaan represented the intromission of the faithful into Heaven.
There sometimes appears a kind of Last Judgment... before the good, when they are being intromitted into Heaven. AC 2130, Explained.

They were in despair... that they could not be intromitted... But it vanished by their being intromitted, that is, being received by angelic Societies: intromission into Heaven is nothing else. The intromission was seen by me... up to twelve Societies, and that the twelfth was intromitted, that is, was received, with greater difficulty... Afterwards there were admitted as it were eight Societies...
After these had been intromitted. Heaven appeared as if shut; for there were many who afterwards wanted to be intromitted, that is, received...
There were also other Spirits... who then wanted to be intromitted, supposing that it is only intromission...
They who are intromitted are received by the angelic Societies with inmost charity and its joy...
Hence it is evident what is signified by being intromitted through the door into Heaven.
When (this Pope) was questioned about his Power of intromitting into Heaven... SE 3648.a.
He was instructed that it is the Lord alone who intromits into Heaven...
From intense longing he importuned that he might be intromitted into Heaven... AC 8847. SE 872.
From this it may be evident that those do not think truly who believe that anyone can be intromitted into Heaven from mercy alone... HH 420:2. HH 525.
After some time they begin to know that no others are intromitted into Heaven than those who have lived the life of faith...

Truth is falsified when it is said that anyone, however he has lived, can be intromitted into Heaven from mercy. Truth is still more falsified when it is said that to a man has been given the Power of intromitting anybody whatever into Heaven.
Those who try (to ascend from a lower Heaven to a higher one) are forthwith intromitted...
As many as want can be admitted into Heaven... They are intromitted into Societies of Angels...
Thus they are instructed... that Heaven is not for anyone by his being received or intromitted.
Intromission and approach to the Lord no otherwise than through the good of love... Signified, Explained.
When they are intromitted into their interiors...
Only the entrances to the Hells appear when they are opened to intromit other like ones.
The business there is to intromit the credulous vulgar into Heaven.
Then the Lord... opens the spiritual mind, and thus intromits the man into Heaven.
An open door = intromission.
(They said) Heavenly happiness... is nothing else than intromission into Heaven, and intromission from Divine grace. (Their experience. CL 10. TCR 641:5. AE 865.)
When you put off the external man and are intromitted into the internal.

Through baptism every Christian man is intromitted and introduced into those things which the Church teaches from the Word concerning the other life... The second gate is the Holy Supper, through which every man who has been prepared... is intromitted and introduced into Heaven.
It has pleased the Lord to open the sight of my spirit, and thus to intromit me into the Spiritual World... TCR 779.
On those who are being intromitted into Heaven...
a. Gate = intromission; here, introspection, which is an intromission of the sight, and the sight is intromitted into Heaven when...
After a man by the opening of his internal sight has been intromitted into Heaven...
In place of miracles at this day there has been effected... intromission into the Spiritual World...
That the second state of this Church was... finally, intromission into the Land of Canaan.
